property_summary: For every input (identifier, time, ancillaryData) C.getPrice(...) is a view that does not return a value (i.e., calling it via a try/catch yields no returned int256 and therefore cannot produce a non-zero returned int256 observable via an external caller); the mutant returns a non-zero int256 for some identifier values, so observing a non-zero returned int256 from getPrice distinguishes the mutant.
change_summary: Replace empty view implementation with returning the negated hash of identifier as int256 to produce differing, input-dependent return values.
